tasks.short: Coordinate furnishing fabrics with interior designers

steps.what: Collaborate with interior designers using room context and physical furnishing fabric samples

tasks.design: Keep material assessment and design collaboration with the upholsterer and designer. A shared reference folder in {DOCS} can support their existing discussion without substituting for physical samples or claiming a separate paperwork saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fabric coordination combines touch, light, room context and trade-offs discussed with the designer.
tasks.enabler_now: Shared images can support a discussion but do not establish equivalent assessment of physical materials.
tasks.still_hard: Screen appearance does not settle texture, practical upholstery suitability or the designer's intent.
tasks.human_edge: The upholsterer explains construction constraints and evaluates materials alongside the designer.
tasks.altitude: Collaboration time and decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Coordinate room materials and furnishing appearance
reach.learn: How lighting, scale and fabric construction affect a room scheme

evidence.claim: Physical fabric assessment and collaborative design judgement remain human work; shared references alone establish no task saving.

assumptions: Boundary is the upholsterer's collaboration about room decoration and furnishing fabrics, excluding fabrication, purchasing and the interior designer's own design work.
The upholsterer evaluates samples and constraints during the discussion; no structured fabric suitability or coordinated-colour flag is assumed.
Consider existing native shared folders before custom software. No new reference recording requirement or automated step is introduced.
Incremental upkeep is zero because the workflow is unchanged. Designer time is not transferred into or deducted from the focal-role denominator.
unknowns: Use of physical samples and existing shared references
research_questions: Is there a separately measured repeated sample lookup task outside the collaboration itself?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 minus0 upkeep gives net0. Familiar fabrics and unfamiliar room schemes both retain direct material assessment and collaboration.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The upholsterer keeps hands-on material judgement and direct collaboration with designers.
reach: Learn room material coordination from interior designers
skills_to_grow: Assessing fabric appearance under room lighting
role.ambitious_version: An upholsterer who contributes clear material and construction advice to coordinated interior schemes.
